name: ProductTour
whenToUse: Introducing what changed on a redesigned screen, once, in 2–5 steps.
Teaching one action by doing it (an `interactive` step).

whenNotToUse.instead: docs, or an empty state with guidance
Help content they can come back to

anatomy.description: the target cut out of a dim; a step without `target` is a centered card.
title, text, optional media, Back / Next, “2 of 4”, Skip.

do.caption: Three steps about what’s new: easy to finish, easy to skip.

dont.caption: Twelve steps pointing at everything: people skip on step 2 and learn nothing.

a11y: Focus moves into the card on every step; ←/→ move between steps, Escape skips.
The page under the dim is inert unless a step is interactive.
Store “seen” in `onComplete`/`onSkip` — don’t show it again on every visit.

props.name: hideSkip
props.description: Hides the Skip button (the close button stays).

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Finished with Done on the last step.

props.name: onSkip
props.description: Closed early (Skip, close button, Esc). Receives the step it was on.
